title: FiT-Central X-Stream League B Meet 1
description: We competed in 5 qualification matches, ending with a record of 2-3-0. A great learning experience to kick off the competition season.

title: FiT-Central X-Stream League B Meet 2
description: We competed in 5 qualification matches, and we ended with a record of 2-2-1. After this comp, we will add better wheels and setup android studio. We did well, and we will strive to be better.

title: FiT-Central X-Stream League B Meet 3
description: This match, we realized something. Ranking points are really important. We ended with a record of 2-3-0, but we increased our RP count to 15 and across our best 10 matches our record is 6-3-1. We will continue to improve for the League Tournament.

title: FiT-Central X-Stream League Tournament
description: We failed this time. That fordn;t mean we will give up. That just means we will try harder, build better, and come back stronger next time.

title: Lightsaders Rookie Invitational
description: We are excited to participate in the Lightsaders Rookie Invitational. This will be a great opportunity to compete against other rookie teams and showcase our skills. We will prepare thoroughly and aim to perform at our best. This is not part of FIRST.
